description: Ministry of Buddahasasana Religione and Cultural Altairs - Declaration of the Sacred region belonging to the historical Sithulpawwa Raja Maha Viharaya in the Yala National Wild Park in Hambantota District as a Sacred Area
categorisation: This gazette primarily deals with land and property matters, specifically the declaration of a sacred area and detailed boundary descriptions of land parcels. It involves land registration, boundary changes, and property designation (declaring "Sithul Pawwa Urban Area" as "Sithulpawwa Sacred Area"). While it mentions government officials (Minister Mahinda Rajapaksa), the core content focuses on land matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
